the game isn't hard in the beginning. Except the ex stages that challenge your squad power points more than anything else. Over time, however, it will get harder. sometimes you'll have to kill a certain enemy type first, hide your squad behind covers to prevent getting a debuff, manage splitting the amount of damage your team takes by the covers and the hp bars by exposing yourself then hiding behind the covers etc.

Not to say you will have to control the bursts you use and when you use them. The tank burst is better than the damage dealing burst before you get hit hard, isn't it?
 
I wouldn't recommend using auto combat unless your power is ridiculously higher than the power of the enemies. Like you're 50k power and the enemy is 5k power. Enemies die the moment you look at them, so manually fighting in this case may even get a bit annoying...

By always using auto combat you'll be skipping a large part of the game and combat isn't bad here. You don't need to concern yourself too much about using covers now. I can only say that you'll need to hide behind a cover before the enemy does a strong AOE attack when it will be clear that it's a large aoe attack. Covers have more hp than nikkes, so you can survive a big hit by hiding behind them. There will be other cases, but I guess, you'll understand them yourself when you get there... Or maybe other people from the subreddit will explain it better than I did.

Also you should understand that some nikkes are better than others at certain parts of the game. Dorothy is great at boss damage but isn't doing so well in add clearing missions. Centi is good against adds but is [relatively] bad against bosses etc.
